description: A list-typed field fed by a children source naming a node that declares no parent: no node of that name is placed under the owner, so the binder hands the field one positional scalar per occurrence, and the conformance pass refuses with KDLITH-SCH020 at the field's site; the passing twins are schemas/vet/feed-children-list (a placed children-fed list) and the placement spelling of schemas/vet/when-branches
